title: OtterPie - one scan, sliced three ways. Automatic payment splitting for sari-sari stores, built on Stellar.
description: Sari-sari store owners juggle supplier payments, daily income, and savings by hand, usually in cash. Otterpie fixes that with one QR code: when a customer pays, the payment is automatically split between the supplier’s share, the store’s income, and a savings pool, all in a single Stellar transaction.
